_allow_power_actions: Set false to disable shutdown/reboot of the rig itself from the console.
_comment: Copy to config.json (default location: ~/.config/octa-host-agent/config.json on Linux, %APPDATA%\octa-host-agent\config.json on Windows) and edit. Delete any line starting with _ to keep the file valid JSON you fully control — the agent only reads the named keys. token is auto-generated on first run if absent.
_cors_origins: Web origins allowed to call the agent. The OctaSpace Hub origin is the default. Add 'null' only if you test with local file:// pages.
_idle_job: mode: off | command | pause. 'command' runs the given shell command while no rental is active (auto start/stop needs octa_api_key for rental detection; manual start/stop always works). 'pause' is a stored preference only — OctaSpace has no API pause switch.
_node_container: docker container name for your node, if not matching orc/octa-node/octaspace.
_node_control: auto | systemd | docker | none. 'auto' tries systemd units then docker containers.
_node_service: systemd unit name for your OctaSpace node, if not one of the auto-detected defaults (octa-node, octaspace-node, octaspace, orc).
_octa_api_key: OPTIONAL. Your OctaSpace API key (from your octa.space account). Stored ONLY in this file on your rig. With it, the agent can list your nodes, apply price changes via the official API (PATCH /nodes/{id}/prices), reboot a node via the API, and auto-detect rentals for idle-job management. Without it, prices are saved on the rig only and the console says so.
_security: The agent listens on your LAN. Every endpoint except /api/health needs the token below. Use over LAN, Tailscale, WireGuard or SSH tunnel ONLY — never port-forward this to the open internet.
